# Exhibitions and catalogue {#sec-exhibitions}

The CPS Wikibase records exhibitions (type Q3) and the catalogue (type Q205) that documents them. Works are linked to exhibitions with *Exhibited at* (P21) and to the catalogue with *Appears in catalogue* (P48). The catalogue statement can carry a *Scan page* qualifier (P49) that points to the page of a digitised copy.
